Database: Import Sets, Transform Maps, Data Sources
Project Details: Project 1:
Project Description
HYGO The project focused on implementing ServiceNow HR Service Delivery (HRSD) to automate HR processes such as employee onboarding, offboarding, case management, document management, and employee self-service. The objective was to improve employee experience, reduce manual HR activities, and streamline HR operations across multiple business units.
Technologies
Responsibilities
ServiceNow HRSD, Employee Center, Flow Designer, Service Catalog, JavaScript, Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, Notifications, REST APIs • Configured HR Services, HR Case Categories, and HR Templates based on business requirements. • Developed custom HR Catalog Items and Record Producers for employee requests. • Created Lifecycle Event (LE) activities for employee onboarding, internal transfers, and offboarding. • Configured HR Assignment Rules, Escalation Rules, and Auto Assignment. • Developed HR Agent Workspace components and customized workspace layouts. • Configured HR Knowledge Base and Employee Centre Portal. • Implemented Document Management for HR policies and employee documentation. • Developed reusable Script Includes, Business Rules, and Client Scripts for HR applications. • Configured ACLs to protect sensitive employee information using HR Criteria.
Implemented Flow Designer for HR Case automation and approval workflows. • Configured Notifications, Email Templates, and Scheduled Reports. • Developed REST integrations with Workday, Active Directory, and Payroll systems.
Project.2
Project
NEXTEC
Description
The project focused on improving Configuration Management Database (CMDB) health by implementing Discovery, Service Mapping, Identification and Reconciliation Engine (IRE), and CMDB Data Manager. The objective was to improve Configuration Item (CI) accuracy, automate infrastructure discovery, and establish service relationships for better IT Operations visibility.
Technologies
Responsibilities
ServiceNow CMDB, Discovery, Service Mapping, IRE, MID Server, JavaScript, Flow Designer, REST APIs • Configured Discovery schedules for Windows, Linux, VMware, Network Devices, and Cloud resources. • Installed, configured, and upgraded MID Servers across multiple environments. • Customized CI Class Manager and CMDB Data Model. • Integrated Discovery with AWS, Azure, VMware, and Kubernetes environments. • Configured Event Management integrations with SolarWinds, Dynatrace, Splunk, and Nagios. • Created REST API integrations for CI synchronization with external asset repositories. • Implemented Service Mapping for critical business applications. • Customized Discovery Patterns and Probes. • Worked on Identification & Reconciliation Rules (IRE). • Improved CMDB Health Dashboard and Data Certification. • Developed Business Rules, Script Includes, and Client Scripts. • Integrated third-party inventory tools using REST APIs. • Created reports for CI completeness and compliance. • Supported production issues and Discovery troubleshooting.
DECLARATION:
I hereby declare that the information furnished above is true to the best of my knowledge.
(Bhavyashree RY)
